summary.note: USC EA already CLOSED prior to this run. Of remaining 9 UNAVAILABLE targets, 3 can be definitively closed as PROGRAM_NOT_OFFERED (school does not have an ED/EA plan for first-year admission per authoritative official sources). The other 6 are genuinely UNAVAILABLE — data exists internally at the school but is not published publicly (Hofstra CDS Issuu-only, UWisconsin doesn't report EA to CDS, UT Austin explicitly refuses, Seton Hall hasn't published CDS since 2004, The New School hasn't published CDS since 2008-09, SLU hasn't published CDS since 2021-22, USD ED inaugural cycle is Fall 2026 with no data yet).

decisions.note: Loyola Chicago's own Common Data Sets for both Fall 2024 (CDS 2024-25, C21) and Fall 2025 (CDS 2025-26, C21) explicitly mark Early Decision = NO. C22 (Early Action) is also NO — Loyola Chicago operates rolling admission only. The edAcceptanceRate field is structurally N/A: there is no ED program to compute a rate for. Task description claim of 'Has ED, CDS on Issuu' was incorrect — LUC publishes CDS on its own OIE site and does not offer ED. Verified via 2 independent CDS years from luc.edu official institutional research.

Adelphi's official First-Year Application page lists only two plans: Early Action (Nov 1, non-binding) and Rolling Admission (Mar 1 priority). No Early Decision option exists. Confirmed by Adelphi's own apply page and US News profile (which also lists EA but not ED). Task description claim of 'Has ED' was incorrect. The edAcceptanceRate field is structurally N/A for Adelphi.

Hofstra's application process page lists Early Action I (Nov 15), Early Action II (Dec 15), and rolling Regular Decision. No Early Decision (binding) option exists. Multiple secondary sources (US News, BigFuture, CollegeVine) all confirm Hofstra offers only EA, not ED. Task description claim 'Has ED' was incorrect — Hofstra's CDS on Issuu (which we cannot extract) reports EA data in C22, not ED in C21. The edAcceptanceRate field is structurally N/A for Hofstra. Note: a separate eaAcceptanceRate target for Hofstra (if it existed) would have the 81.4% figure widely reported but unverifiable to source CDS.

stillUnavailable.reason: UT Austin's first EA cycle (Class of 2030, Fall 2026) decisions released January 15, 2026. UT Austin explicitly does not publish acceptance rate data by admission round — confirmed by Top Tier Admissions, Ivy Coach, and admissions.utexas.edu silence on EA splits. No data exists publicly to import.

UWisconsin does NOT report EA data to the Common Data Set (confirmed by Ivy Coach 'Wisconsin has not shared any acceptance rate data about its EA program publicly' and confirmed via UW-Madison's own data.wisc.edu admissions trends which break out only residency/gender/race, not EA vs RD). 2024-25 CDS PDF was retrieved but contains no EA breakdown. Genuine institutional non-disclosure.

SLU's ED program started with Fall 2022 entering class. However, SLU's Office of Institutional Research has not published a Common Data Set newer than 2021-2022 (URLs /2223cds, /2324cds, /2425cds all return 404). The 2021-22 CDS notes 'Early decision will begin with the Fall 2022 entering class' — meaning ED data exists internally for 4 cycles (Fall 2022 through Fall 2025) but has never been published publicly. No press releases break out ED stats. Recommend re-checking SLU OIR quarterly.

USD just introduced ED for the Class of 2030 (Fall 2026 entering class) — confirmed via College Confidential thread 'University of San Diego Now Offers EA and ED for Class of 2030'. USD's official 2024-25 CDS (covering Fall 2024) marks C21 ED = Yes with closing date 11/1, notification 12/15, but applicant/admit fields are blank because the first ED cycle has not yet happened. Data will not exist until 2026-27 CDS publication (likely March 2027). Genuine 'too new' UNAVAILABLE.

Seton Hall has not published a Common Data Set since 2004-05 (verified on shu.edu/institutional-research/reports.html — most recent CDS link is 2004-2005). News.shu.edu publishes overall class profile (e.g., 28,000 applicants, 1,625 enrolled for Class of 2029, ~69% overall) but never breaks out EA. Counselor handbook also only states overall '69% acceptance rate'. No public EA data.

The New School offers binding Early Decision for Lang/Parsons (deadline Nov 15) confirmed via newschool.edu/admission/.../early-application-options/. However, The New School's most recent public CDS is 2008-2009 (archived in newschool archives). No newer CDS published. Aggregator '93.7% early acceptance rate' is unsourced and likely reflects overall EA pool blended with ED. No reliable public ED stats.
